items.title: Clarins Family Takes Full Ownership of Luxury Hotel Group Evok
items.why: Single-owner luxury hotel groups may become a new operator to pursue for hotel and lifestyle benefit partnerships.
items.summary_ai: The Courtin family behind Clarins now fully owns luxury hotel group Evok, controlling its buildings, brands and operations.
items.take: Single-owner luxury hotel groups may become a new operator to pursue for hotel and lifestyle benefit partnerships.
